what: Planned interface contract for Assault Rifle AR-01: SM_AR01 (rifle, magazine removed) and SM_AR01_Mag (separate magazine). Written by the game+tech planning role 2026-10-04. Every *_nominal value is a rough sheet reading scaled to 880 mm overall; the study's ar01_spec.json overrides it and the builder recomputes from the spec. Companion: RIFLE_BUILD_PLAN.md.
status: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-04 by rifle_spec.json (generated by tools/make_spec.py) after the study merge and the adversarial check. Do not copy names, paths, slots, sockets, gates or numbers from original_plan_superseded; it is kept only for the plan's reasoning.

assets.static_twin: SM_AR01 (mag merged by default, gun study Q3)

layout.standard: GUN_BUILDING_STUDY 4.7 / 11.8 (Q20 default); this block is the one place builders copy paths from
sources: Assets/Guns/AR01_Mag.blend (magazine, fitted to the exported rifle bytes)
layout.exports: Exports/Guns/AR01/: SK_AR01*.fbx, SK_AR01.skeletal.json, A_AR01_*.fbx, SM_AR01.fbx + SM_AR01.sockets.json, SM_AR01_Mag.fbx + SM_AR01_Mag.sockets.json, Physics/, Textures/ (+ Recolour/), README.md, MATERIALS_README.md
layout.scripts: Scripts/guns/rifle/ (build_rifle.py staged, lock asserted at the top; rifle_parts.py; run_rifle.sh); shared code moves to Scripts/guns/gunlib/ only when the SMG needs it; ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
layout.work: WorkFiles/guns/rifle/ (spec, reports, UnrealCheck/); scratch/ and build/ are not committed

where_each_old_block_now_lives.sockets: rifle_spec.json sockets (GUN_BUILDING_STUDY 5.3 names; plan names kept as plan_name)
where_each_old_block_now_lives.materials: rifle_spec.json materials (M_AR01_Metal / M_AR01_Furniture / M_AR01_Mag on M_Fabric_Master)
where_each_old_block_now_lives.collision: rifle_spec.json collision_static_twin (7 hulls incl. the merged mag + 2 on the mag)
where_each_old_block_now_lives.moving_parts_kept_separate_until_join: rifle_spec.json bones + parts[].joint (no hammer; dust cover fixed)

reference_notes: the top-left panel labelled LEFT shows the selector side with the muzzle to the right = the RIGHT side (agrees with the 'receiver and selector (right)' close-up and the 3/4 front-right view)
the top-right panel labelled RIGHT (muzzle left) also draws a selector: very likely mirrored; used as the left silhouette without the mirrored selector unless the user decides otherwise
the sheet ruler reads ~97 cm: scale is set from the real pattern (~880 mm overall, ~415 mm barrel)

names.forbidden_in_names: no real-pattern or maker names, no logos, stamps, serials; the qa_check deny list must pass

frames.units: Blender metres (modelled in mm), unit scale 1.0; Unreal cm after export (FBX units scale)

export_axes.mapping: Blender (x, y, z) m -> Unreal (100x, -100y, 100z) cm (helpers.ue_socket_transform)

rifle.origin: Grip: centre of the right hand on the pistol-grip centre line, mid-plane y=0, 40 mm (nominal) down the grip axis from the grip/receiver junction

blender_axes.+X: toward the muzzle; the bore axis is exactly parallel to X at y=0, z=bore_z
blender_axes.-Y: the rifle's RIGHT side (selector, ejection port, charging handle)

rifle.blender_front_view: from -Y: the right side with the muzzle to screen right = the sheet's top-left panel
rifle.attach_convention: weapon origin = Grip snaps (SnapToTarget) to a weapon socket on hand_r; the socket's rotation is tuned once in Unreal on the player skeleton

mag.axes: identical to the rifle's MagWell socket frame when seated: zero relative transform
mag.reload_path: MagInsertStart --(lerp location, rotation constant)--> MagRockStart --(slerp rotation, location constant = pure rotation about the lug)--> MagWell; removal = the reverse

bounding_sphere_radius_m.note: measured by the build and in Unreal; the mag screen sizes are re-derived from the measured values

sockets.how: Empties SOCKET_<LOD0 node>_<name> made with helpers.make_socket (ue_correction on); written to <name>.sockets.json by export_fbx; applied after import by ue_import_sockets.py (a LodGroup FBX drops sockets; FBX sockets arrive at scale 100)

rifle.use: Pivot; snaps to the character's weapon socket on hand_r
left-hand IK target on the lower handguard
bottom centre of the rear notch (aim point)
eye point on the line SightFront->SightRear, 300 mm behind the notch; the ADS camera aligns here and may slide along its X
seated magazine pivot = front-lug hook point; SM_AR01_Mag 'Attach' snaps here with ZERO relative transform

start of the rock-in: same location as MagWell, mag base swung FORWARD by theta (lug hooked). Blender rotation_euler.y = -theta; the final sign is written by ue_socket_transform and confirmed by a test
rifle.rule: smallest angle at which the mag's rear top corner clears the catch by 2 mm with the lug hooked

rifle.use: before the lug enters its recess: MagRockStart moved along the tilted mag's local -Z
thumb/finger target on the catch paddle
case ejection FX; socket +X = ejection direction (right, slightly forward and up); gameplay-tunable

rifle.stroke_note: set by the study only if a skeletal or carrier variant is made

rifle.use: finger target on the lever tab
butt plate centre; shoulder contact for third-person aim offsets / IK
rifle.plate_normal: computed by the build and recorded here

rifle.use: computed from part volumes x densities, scaled to the nominal mass; buyers set the body CoM offset to it

rifle.condition: only if the sheet shows the front loop
only if the sheet shows the rear loop

mag.use: pivot = front-lug hook point; equals the rifle's MagWell when seated
left palm on the mag body; the hand_l skeleton socket's relative transform = inverse(HandReload)
top centre of the feed lips (round visual / ammo FX)
floor plate centre; drop impact FX

gates.S2_sight_picture: render from ADS at 1440p: post centred in the notch within 0.5 px laterally, post top on the notch line within 0.5 px
gates.unreal: same count, scale 1, outered to the asset (fresh process), 0.000 cm / 0.000 deg vs the sidecar, no extras

budgets_triangles.rule: LODs from the same generators at lower resolution with the same UV islands; strictly descending in Blender, FBX and Unreal

lods.mag_rule: size_mag = size_rifle x r_mag / r_rifle (measured Unreal bounds), so both switch at the same distance; gate: switch distances within 5 %
lods.formula: UE screen size = 2 * max(0.5*P00, 0.5*P11) * r / d ~= 1.78 r/d at 16:9, 90 deg hFOV
lods.measurement_gate: render each switch at its distance, 2560x1440, 90 deg hFOV, 4 headings: mean silhouette diff <= 1 px, max <= 3 px; sights, front-sight ears and the brake cut still read at LOD1->LOD2. REQUIRED (the katana's was never run)
lods.lod3: not in this contract (open question); ~1.2k rifle / ~200 mag at ~20 m for the battle royale

rifle_slots.buyer_control: Steel Tint (clamped multiplier: subtle on dark blued steel)
rifle_slots.parts: receiver, dust cover, carrier, sights, barrel, gas tube, blocks, brake, rod, trigger group, selector, retainer bands, butt plate, screws, rivets, sling loops
stock, pistol grip, upper and lower handguards
rifle_slots.rule: wood BC authored as one stain hue x the luminance detail so the recolour default equals the shipped BC (p99.9 <= 2 levels)

mag_slots.buyer_control: Steel Tint (set together with MI_AR01_Steel by the game's cosmetic code)

materials.conditional_slot: M_AR01_Grip (M_Fabric_Master, recolourable) only if the study finds a non-wood pistol grip
materials.material_spec: items AR01 and AR01_Mag, changes_v9_ar01 (additions only)

atlases.name: T_AR01_Wood_Detail16
atlases.note: square required (mip_level uses one Detail Map Size); matched to BC because it carries the grain

formats.ORM: linear, TC_Masks; R baked AO (Cycles, Extend margin) / G roughness / B metallic; composite = its own N, CTM_NormalRoughnessToGreen; Texture Group World
formats.N: DirectX (green flipped on write), TC_Normalmap, flip green OFF in Unreal
formats.all: power of two, full mips (13 levels at 4096, 12 at 2048); padding 16 px at 2K, 32 px at 4K

textures.uv1: authored non-overlapping pack inside 0..1; Unreal Generate Lightmap UVs ON, lightmap index 1; no chart under 4 px at lightmap resolution 64
textures.qa_texel_note: qa_check uses max(image.size) per object, so its aggregate is approximate on mixed atlas sizes; the builder's per-atlas report is the authority and qa --texel = measured aggregate +-25 %

collision.rule: UCX_<LOD0 node>_NN, <= 32 verts each, built from dense surface samples (<= 1 mm LOD0, <= 2 mm LOD1/2), dilated 0.2 mm, neighbours overlap 3 mm

rifle.name: UCX_SM_AR01_LOD0_00
rifle.covers: receiver, dust cover, rear sight block, selector, charging handle

rifle.name: UCX_SM_AR01_LOD0_01
rifle.covers: fore-end: both handguards + barrel and gas tube between the receiver and the gas block

rifle.name: UCX_SM_AR01_LOD0_02
rifle.covers: gas block, exposed barrel, rod up to the front sight block

rifle.name: UCX_SM_AR01_LOD0_03
rifle.covers: front sight block + post + muzzle brake

mag.name: UCX_SM_AR01_Mag_LOD0_00
mag.covers: upper half of the curve (lugs, lips)

gates.C1_build: 0 of a jittered 0.5 mm LOD0 sampling and 0 vertices of any LOD outside the hull union
gates.C2_unreal: 0 of 300,000 LOD0 samples outside Unreal's stored hulls (FBX round trip)

collision.in_play: held: NoCollision/QueryOnly; dropped: simple collision, physics on, mass override (3.1 kg rifle, 0.33/0.82 kg mag), CoM offset from CenterOfMass; seated mag collision off; no complex-as-simple

fit_gates.construction: the mag top (hidden in the well) is fitted to the EXPORTED rifle bytes (sha256 guard); the exterior comes from the sheet's mag close-ups; lateral clearance 0.3 mm/side, lug recess 0.2 mm, top stop 0.2 mm, rear lug to catch 0.1 mm

M4_rock_path.allowance: mag rear lug vs catch nose <= 3.0 mm penetration, only in the last <= 6 deg (spring-loaded catch; reported per step)

fit_gates.M8_info: a straight vertical insert is reported (expected to collide)
fit_gates.M9_unreal: mag at MagWell: composed sockets <= 0.001 cm; seated fit on the read-back geometry 0 intersections

look_gates.method: orthographic renders of the shipped FBX with the shipped maps vs the TRACED reference at the sheet's scale, similarity fit (scale + translation, rotation <= 0.5 deg)

L7_blind.plus: no confident design tell; stop and show the user if the first 4 pairs are all picked for a design reason

unreal.guard: WorkFiles/shuriken/UnrealCheck6/wait_unreal_free.ps1; one commandlet at a time; none left running
unreal.import: legacy FBX importer; Convert Scene ON, Force Front X OFF, Convert Scene Unit ON, Uniform Scale 1.0, Import Normals + MikkTSpace, Do Not Create Material, Auto Generate Collision OFF, One Convex Hull per UCX ON, Import Mesh LODs ON, Generate Lightmap UVs ON (dst 1), Nanite OFF; then ue_import_sockets.py per sidecar
passes: C renders (sight picture, LOD switches, depth)
gates: LOD count 3, triangles equal in Blender/FBX/Unreal
sha256 of the bytes match; promote to engine-verified only then

build_order: 2 form -> L2 L3 L5 + early look
4 game (LODs, hulls, sockets, join) -> qa, C1, S1, S2, LOD-pop gate
6 mag fitted to the rifle bytes -> M1-M8, L4, qa
10 docs + showcase + ASSET_LIST row; release lock AR01

moving_parts_kept_separate_until_join.record: pivot + axis per part in ar01_parts.json, so a skeletal SK_AR01 (bone names = socket names) is a re-export

open_questions: static two meshes (as asked) vs + SM_AR01_Carrier vs skeletal SK_AR01 (Fab firearms reportedly 'rigged and animated'); GUN_BUILDING_STUDY.md may settle it for every gun
left receiver side: real pattern (plain) or as drawn (mirrored selector)
LOD3 for the battle royale now or later
Steel Tint enough for v1, or a weapon-skin master later
rear sight leaf graduations: omit (default) or plain ticks
go-ahead for the Weapon_R / Mag_L skeleton sockets in the game project
showcase section: 'Throwables and weapons' or a new 'Firearms'
